svg.text: LOLIN S2 MINI + L298N • DIGITAL MOTOR ENABLE • GPIO MAP MATCHES config.h
+5V terminal: leave open unless your exact module docs say otherwise
V+ ← buck 5 V • GND → common GND
− → GND; add a driver transistor if required
COMMON GROUND: battery − • buck IN−/OUT− • L298N GND • ESP32 GND • servo GND • LED cathodes • buzzer −
Remove ENA/ENB jumper caps when GPIO 11/12 drive them. • Measure the buck output at 5.00 V first.
Do not feed raw 2S battery voltage into ESP32 5V/3V3. Keep grounds common. Lift the wheels for the first tests.
